# turn 2: the words the definitions of turn 1 need.  Written by Claude (Opus 5.5), 2026-10-30.
third: the next one after the first two
person: a thing that can know, can say what it can do, and can do it
persons: more than one person
man: a person that the account says is mr
who: what person
works: work, for one thing now
work: a thing that a person makes, or a change that a person makes, for money
bank: a place that can store money for a person, and give it out
money: a thing that a person can give to get a thing
roofs: more than one roof
roof: the last part of a house that a person makes
house: a thing that a person makes, so that persons can be in it
throw: make a thing go from the hand of a person
came: a word for come, when it is before now
about: of
year: a time that is a set number of days
offence: a thing that a rule says a person can not do
offences: more than one offence
taking: take, when it is now
